name: BioMysteryBench
intro: BioMysteryBench 是 Anthropic 构建的生物信息学科研基准。当前 v11 在对历史 99 题进行全量专家和多模型答案键审计后，删除 9 题、修订 24 题，保留 90 题（73 题人类可解、17 题人类困难）。每题以验证 Notebook 证明信号存在，智能体可自由选择分析路线，但最终答案按 rubric 全有或全无评分。
build_method: 领域专家客观真值命题、强制验证Notebook、最多五位专家人类基线、v11全量专家与多模型答案键审计
modality: 组学数据, 文本, 代码
task_type: 生物信息学Agent, 开放式科研问题, 端到端数据分析
eval_feature: 禁止凭accession反查来源、允许标准数据库分析、反作弊、最终答案rubric全有或全无评分、每题五次episode
scale: 当前v11共90题（73道人类可解、17道人类困难）；历史v8为99题，v11删除9题并修订24题
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Anthropic's 2026-04-29 methodology article, BioMysteryBench-full commit b5a889c, and preview changelog commit 51c9024. The current v11 path requires a validation notebook before packaging, asks up to five experts to solve each task, classifies a task human-solvable after at least one correct answer, and routes zero-correct tasks to extra QC. A June 2026 full expert and multi-model answer-key audit transformed historical v8's 99 tasks by removing 9 and revising 24, yielding v11's 90 tasks: 73 human-solvable and 17 human-hard. The evaluation explicitly prohibits accession-ID reverse lookup to recover the source study while allowing standard bioinformatics database use, runs agents in a tool-installable container for five episodes per task, and applies method-agnostic all-or-nothing final-answer rubrics with accuracy and solve-consistency reporting.
task_type_en: Bioinformatics agent, open-ended research problem, end-to-end data analysis
build_method_en: Domain-expert objective-ground-truth questions, mandatory validation notebooks, up-to-five-expert human baselines, full v11 expert and multi-model answer-key audit
eval_feature_en: No accession reverse lookup, standard database analysis allowed, anti-cheat, all-or-nothing final-answer rubrics, five episodes per task
intro_en: BioMysteryBench is Anthropic's bioinformatics research benchmark. The current v11 follows a full expert and multi-model answer-key audit of the historical 99-task release: 9 tasks were removed and 24 revised, leaving 90 tasks (73 human-solvable and 17 human-hard). A mandatory validation notebook demonstrates that each signal exists; agents may choose any analytical route, but the final answer is graded all-or-nothing against the rubric.
